description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of matches across seven distinct categories. The chart consists of seven slices, which are arranged clockwise in descending numerical order based on their category labels, starting from the top left. The largest slice, labeled "6 Matches," is colored light blue and accounts for 27.2% (8006) of the total. Continuing clockwise, the next slice is labeled "5," colored a lighter blue, representing 10.4% (3043). This is followed by the "4" slice in very light blue at 6.2% (1810), and the "3" slice in light greenish-beige at 6.8% (2002). The "2" slice is pale green and makes up 22.4% (6583), while the "1" slice is pale yellow, comprising 13.8% (4046). Finally, the "0" slice is colored cream and represents 13.3% (3910). The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, the category labels are positioned just outside their respective slices. Both the percentage and the raw count (enclosed in parentheses) are displayed directly inside each segment. All slices are contiguous and separated by thin white borders, with no segments visually emphasized through exploding, offsetting, or bolding.
